record.title: The First Dream
record.premise: Vosh-Leera's cup of sap shows the player a young Hist and a reed hide; at Teel-Fen Weir they find the young tree's scar sealed with a grey paste, take a jar and a note from the hide's sap-takers, and tell the tree's minder the truth or a comfort.
record.foundation: Built from main-plot.md §5 quest 3. Vosh-Leera gives the player a cup of sap (Skyrim's potion bottle under our name); the player drinks it in front of her by a line. The stage it sets fades the screen to black and shows the vision's words on a message box while it is black (the approved fade-with-message block); the player then tells it to her line by line, and she names Teel-Fen Weir, south of the town, whose young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa's roots. Heem-Jasa shows the grey paste in the young tree's closed scar and points to the reed hide by the lone dead tree west of the weir, where three Unbound sap-takers keep jars of sap. The player fights them, shoots them from cover or passes them by stealth to take the note (taking it moves the quest; a jar lies beside it to take as well). Back on the platform Heem-Jasa asks whether her tree will live: the truth opens her Alchemy training (Adept) and her stall; a comfort gives three potions of Cure Poison on the spot and leaves her training and stall closed. The note orders the crew to bring their jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, which starts MN04.

truth.what: Three Unbound sap-takers came by night, cut the young Hist's scar, drained it into clay jars and pressed a grey paste into the cut, which closed over it. They keep the jars at a reed hide by a lone dead tree west of the weir, waiting for orders to carry them on.
A note from their crew's master reached the hide, ordering them to bring their jars to Karsh-Naal Camp.
Vosh-Leera has a cup of Jal-Veesa's last sap, drawn before its scar closed. Tree-minders drink sap to ask the trees a question; she means the stranger to drink it and ask where the sickness is.

topics.label: You said you had a second task for me.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: she gives the player a cup of Jal-Veesa's sap, the last drawn before its scar closed. Tree-minders drink it to ask the trees a question, and the trees are joined at the root, so what one has seen the others can show. She wants the player to drink it here, in front of her, and ask where the sickness is; a stranger's eyes are as good as any. Then tell her everything they see. Does: sets stage 20, whose start gives the cup. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: I'll drink it now.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: she says to drink it all, and not to fight what comes. Does: sets stage 30, whose start takes the cup, fades the screen to black and shows the vision on a message box. Checks: hasItem the cup.

topics.label: I saw a young Hist among stilt huts.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: a young tree; she asks what was beside it (a question; its answer is topic.mn03-tell-weir). Does: nothing. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: A woven weir across a creek, beside the tree.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: a young tree by a weir; she knows one; she asks what else they saw (a question; its answer is topic.mn03-tell-hide). Does: nothing. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: West of the weir, a reed hide by a lone dead tree, with jars in its shade.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: that is Teel-Fen Weir, a weir-wardens' camp of the Sedge-Wardens a short walk south of the town down the creek, where a young Hist grew from the roots of Jal-Veesa's own tree. Its minder is Heem-Jasa; go to her on the platform round the tree. Jars by a hide mean someone is keeping sap; the player is to see what Heem-Jasa knows first, and be careful at the hide. Does: sets stage 40. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: Tell me about Teel-Fen Weir.
topics.intent: Vosh-Leera. Tells: five warden families on a stilt platform at the weir south of the town, keeping eel traps; their young tree rose from Jal-Veesa's roots within living memory, and they are wary of strangers. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Who are you?
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: tree-minder of Teel-Fen Weir; she tends the young tree and makes remedies from its sap and the marsh's fungus, and sells them to the wardens. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa sent me. What is wrong with your tree?
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: she shows the player the young tree's scar, low on the trunk on the platform side: three nights ago it closed over a grey paste, and none of her people put it there. Something was pressed into the cut. The tree was drained, then sealed. Strangers come and go at the reed hide by the lone dead tree west of the weir; the wardens keep away from them. There are three. The player can go at them, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or creep round to the hide's open west side where they stack their jars. She teaches alchemy and sells sap, fungus and eggshells, but only to kin and to those who are straight with her. Does: sets stage 50. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: I found the hide.
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: she sees the note and the jar, if the player has one, and knows it is her tree's sap. She asks whether her tree will live (a question; its answers are topic.mn03-truth and topic.mn03-comfort). Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: It may die. I won't lie to you.
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: she thanks the player for not lying. From now on she will teach them alchemy and sell them sap, swamp fungus and eggshells. Does: sets stage 90. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: It will live.
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: she is glad, and gives the player three potions of Cure Poison for the road. Does: sets stage 91, whose start gives them. Checks: nothing.

topics.label: Will you teach me, or sell to me?
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa, before the truth or after a comfort. Tells: she teaches and trades only with kin and with those who have been straight with her. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: What is Karsh-Naal Camp?
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells: a camp of tribeless Naga in the marsh east of the weir, about as far again as Jal-Veesa is from here; they rob the road and sell their blades to whoever pays. Nobody from the weir goes there. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

topics.label: What was Umbriel?
topics.intent: Heem-Jasa. Tells, in a line: the flying city the An-Xileel called down on Lilmoth through its mad tree; she hopes no one is doing anything like it to hers. Checks: nothing. Does: nothing.

Go to Vosh-Leera with the note, ask Heem-Jasa about Karsh-Naal Camp, or trade with her. 4. I do not know where Karsh-Naal Camp is, who the master is, what the grey paste is, or whether the tree will live.

state.notes: Notes: I serve Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who works for the Toh-Reel-Ka. I drank Hist sap, saw Teel-Fen Weir, and went to Heem-Jasa, minder of the young Hist there. Her tree was drained and sealed with grey paste three nights ago. At the Sap-Takers hide west of the weir I took their note: their master orders jars brought to Karsh-Naal Camp and every scar sealed. I told Heem-Jasa, as a comfort, that her tree will live; I do not truly know it. She gave me 3 Cure Poison potions and trades or teaches only with the straight. I still have about 50 gold, two lockpicks, and the note. Unknown: location of Karsh-Naal Camp, who the master is, what the grey paste is, why they take sap. Next: report to Vosh-Leera, ask Heem-Jasa about Karsh-Naal Camp, and ask Weeltul about sap, scar and Umbriel.

know_text: I am a hunter freed from the Owing at Ashgate Landing by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. I picked Sithis' beard at Reed-Sill Weir without a fight and gave it to Weeltul, the tree-minder. It only warms the pool. Jal-Veesa's Hist is dying: dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool. Nobody knows why, and trees are sickening along the river. I received the Hist's blessing and 50 gold. Vosh-Leera told me privately that she serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel, who rule the province. They exist to stop another Umbriel-type disaster. They use friendless strangers like me as cheap spies. She wants me back at her House in Jal-Veesa for a second task, which I have not yet taken. I carry 50 gold and two lockpicks. Unknowns: why the trees are sick, and what the second task is. Weeltul has topics on the sap, the scar and Umbriel that I have not asked about.
